Nigeria startup funding reached US$635 million in the first nine months of 2026, reclaiming Africa’s top position for the first time since 2022.

Nigerian startups raised US$635 million between January and September 2026. That compares with US$247 million in the same period of 2025 — a 157 per cent increase, according to funding data published in October 2026.

It is also the highest recorded January-to-September total for Nigeria since 2022.

## **Large rounds drive the rebound**
[Moove](https://www.moove.io/) led the charge. The mobility fintech raised US$250 million in a Series C in August 2026, reaching a reported valuation of US$2.1 billion.

Three other companies also contributed substantially to the total. [Flutterwave](https://flutterwave.com/) secured US$100 million in fresh capital. [Jumia](https://group.jumia.com/) raised US$50 million in post-IPO equity. [Yellow Card](https://yellowcard.io/) closed a US$40 million round, according to October 2026 funding reports.

**How much did Nigerian startups raise in 2026?**

Nigerian startups raised US$635 million between January and September 2026, according to funding data published in October 2026.

Four companies drove the bulk of the total: Moove (US$250 million Series C), Flutterwave (US$100 million), Jumia (US$50 million post-IPO equity) and Yellow Card (US$40 million), per October 2026 funding reports.

## Bumpa: The Nigerian E-Commerce App Helping Over 100,000 Small Businesses Sell Online and Manage Operations
In a country where small businesses drive the majority of economic activity, the tools available to Nigerian entrepreneurs have historically been inadequate — fragmented, expensive, or designed for markets with fundamentally different infrastructure. **Bumpa** set out to change that. Founded in 2021 by **Kelvin Umechukwu** and the late **Adetunji Opayele**, Bumpa is a mobile-first e-commerce platform that gives Nigerian small business owners everything they need to create an online store, manage inventory, process payments, communicate with customers, and analyze their business performance — all from a single app on their phone.

With over **100,000 downloads** on Google Play, a $4 million seed round led by Base10 Partners, and a growing community of merchants across Nigeria and beyond, Bumpa has established itself as one of the most important tools in the Nigerian small business ecosystem. It's not just an app — it's a complete business operating system designed specifically for how African entrepreneurs actually work.

## Funding and Investor Confidence
Bumpa's growth has attracted significant investor interest from both local and international venture capital firms.

**Pre-Seed Round ($200,000):** Bumpa's initial fundraise brought together an impressive group of early-stage investors including **Microtraction**, Whogohost Venture Arm, Greencap Equity, Aidi Ventures, Rizq Investment Group, DFS Labs, HOAQ Club, and several angel investors.

The total funding of $4.2 million positions Bumpa well for its next phase of growth.

# [CareerBuddy Weekly](https://careerbuddynewsletter.substack.com/)
## Pricing: Accessible by Design
These price points — roughly $3-6 USD per month — make Bumpa one of the most affordable comprehensive business management platforms available to African entrepreneurs.

## The Market Opportunity
Bumpa operates in an enormous addressable market.

## Impact and What's Next
Each merchant who transitions from managing orders via WhatsApp screenshots to a structured system on Bumpa represents a small but meaningful step toward a more organized, data-driven business ecosystem.

Looking ahead, Bumpa's $4 million seed funding positions it for expansion across Africa, where similar small business management challenges exist in markets like Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, and beyond.

For Nigerian entrepreneurs looking to take their business to the next level — whether that's moving from WhatsApp-only sales to a proper online store, or adding structure to an already-growing operation — Bumpa represents the most accessible and comprehensive starting point available today.
